bridgeUrl.label: Bridge address
bridgeUrl.description: Where the FreeRDP bridge container listens. Empty uses RDP_BRIDGE_URL, or termix-rdp-bridge:30020.

enable.label: Direct RDP
enable.description: Pass the server's own H.264 frames to the browser instead of going through guacd. Needs the bridge container, and the page must be served over HTTPS.

port.label: RDP port
port.description: The port the host listens on for RDP.

enablePrinting.label: Printing
enablePrinting.description: Offer a printer to the session. Off by default: it has only been tried on a few Windows versions.

status.noSecureContext: Direct RDP needs a secure context. Open Termix over HTTPS and try again.
status.noDecoder: This browser cannot decode H.264 in a worker (WebCodecs is missing).
